title: Replacement Prescription ID Cards on the Pharmacy Benefit Plan
content:
A replacement prescription ID card is issued on request to a member whose Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment is active, in COBRA continuation or pending effective.

## Desk rules

- **Status.** A replacement card may be issued only while the enrollment is pending effective, active or in COBRA continuation. The status is read from the enrollment record before the card is issued.
- **Mailed cards.** Mailed replacements are limited to the design's mailed replacement limit per member per plan year, and a mailed card arrives in the design's stated number of business days. The count is the number of mailed replacement cards issued on this enrollment in the current plan year, from the plan year's start date through today, inclusive.
- **Digital wallet.** Once the mailed limit is reached, further replacements are issued to the digital wallet only. Digital wallet cards are never limited.
- **Address.** A card is never mailed to an address other than the one on file.

## Status and issuance

| Enrollment status | A replacement card may be issued |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| COBRA continuation | Yes |
| COBRA grace | No |
| Terminated | No |

## Mailed or digital (hypothetical design with a mailed limit of 4)

| Mailed replacements already issued this plan year | Next replacement |
|---|---|
| 0 | May be mailed or issued to the digital wallet |
| 3 | May be mailed (the fourth) or issued to the digital wallet |
| 4 | Digital wallet only |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A member whose enrollment is in COBRA grace asks for a replacement card. The enrollment is not pending effective, active or in COBRA continuation, so no replacement card is issued while it stands in COBRA grace.
- A member asks that the mailed card go to a different address from the one on file. The card is not mailed to that address; a mailed card goes only to the address on file.
- Mailed replacements counted in an earlier plan year do not count toward the current plan year's limit, because the limit is per plan year.
